prereg.question: Can the SELECTION step -- picking which of the ~24 attribute names a vault already holds a question is about -- be solved without an LLM or a cross-encoder?

baseline.what: the shipped nanomem v3 engine at git 88dfac9, gold write gate (the L1 rung of chat_target_decision.json), conversational document and query form, temporal_direction='current', router OFF, PCA screen OFF, default query_intents
baseline.reproduced_by_this_file: arm A0; the run aborts if it does not reproduce

prereg.metric: top-1 = chat_bench_v2 expected_substring appears in the rank-1 hit's text; a question whose answer the write gate dropped scores 0

split.rule: every weight, threshold and policy is chosen on dev; test is run once, in one pass, for all arms together

seeds.training: closed-form ridge and counting -- no stochastic training

bar.primary: on the TEST split, overall top-1: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound on (arm - baseline) > 0 AND point delta >= +5.0 pt
bar.reported_but_not_the_bar: head-dropped subset top-1, selection accuracy, and the per-mechanism arms

prereg.known_confound_declared_up_front: chat_bench_v2 draws its question wording from one template per (attribute, question type, head-survives) cell, and dev and test personas share that template table and the same 22 attributes.  Any mechanism fitted on dev QUESTION WORDING -- (b) and (c) -- can therefore transfer to test by recognising a template rather than by understanding the question.  Because that confound is measurable, a second bar is pre-registered:
prereg.bar_generalisation: arm A8, the ATTRIBUTE-AGNOSTIC ensemble, carries no dev-fitted wording->attribute component, and is additionally validated on dev by LEAVE-ONE-ATTRIBUTE-OUT, in which the model never sees a single question about the attribute it is asked to select.  It is held to the same +5.0 pt / CI>0 bar and is reported whether it passes or fails.
oracles_declared: A9 ORACLE SELECTION -- the gold record's own detected entity is handed to the engine.  It is a headroom reference, never a mechanism.  Audited: the tag is keyed by qid, served to exactly the question it was registered for, and any cross-serve raises.

D_ANSWER_TYPE_CEILING -- the gold attribute's own value-shape signature is used as the question's answer type, to separate 'value shape does not discriminate' from 'the question does not reveal the answer type'.  Diagnostic only; never an arm.
prereg.clean_negative_is_a_deliverable: every arm is reported, including the ones hoped for.  If nothing clears +5.0 the file says so and that confirms the LLM / cross-encoder conclusion.

quarantine.mechanism: quarantine_guard.enforce() -- builtins.open, io.open, os.open, os.fdopen and numpy.load refuse the quarantined fixtures in this process
quarantine.names_in_this_source: none.  This file never spells a quarantined filename; the barrier is imported.

witness.fields: size+mtime+ctime per file, recorded by quarantine_guard
witness.note: non-MODIFICATION witness only; atime is not a read witness here

dev_note: trained arms are scored leave-one-persona-out on dev; the model that scored a dev persona never saw that persona.

value_shape_separability_dev.reading: value shape is NOT the bottleneck: knowing an attribute's exact value-shape signature narrows ~24 candidates to ~2.7 and, with a group-cosine tiebreak, selects correctly most of the time.  Inferring that shape FROM THE QUESTION is the bottleneck.

leave_one_attribute_out_selection_dev._reading: the honest generalisation check.  A mechanism that only recognises dev question TEMPLATES scores here the way it would on an attribute a real user invents.

audit_weight_provenance_dev.procedure:
Deterministic and fully specified so that the answer is checkable rather
    than asserted: start from all zeros; sweep the columns in ``SIG`` order;
    set each to the grid value that maximises selection accuracy over ``rows``,
    holding the others fixed; ties go to the SMALLER weight (so the search
    cannot buy a tie with a bigger model); repeat until a whole pass changes
    nothing or ``passes`` is spent.
audit_weight_provenance_dev.note: the objective is dev SELECTION ACCURACY, not end-to-end top-1, which is what the frozen comment claims. Nothing here re-selects anything: the test pass uses the frozen literals whatever this finds.

verdict.the_claim_that_is_WITHDRAWN: 'A7's weights come from coordinate ascent on dev leave-one-PERSONA-out selection accuracy; A8's from dev leave-one-ATTRIBUTE-out' was a source comment with no search, no log and no committed hash behind it. The search did not exist in the deliverable, so the claim was not checkable. It is checkable now, and it does not check out: neither declared reading of that procedure reproduces either literal.
what_replaces_it_and_is_mechanical: both literals lie on the coarse grid the report claims, [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0]
A7's literal IS a coordinate-wise local optimum of the stated dev objective: all 27 single-coordinate moves were scored and the best is +0.00 pt.
A8's literal is NOT: setting atype_hand to 0.25 gains +0.93 pt on dev leave-one-attribute-out selection accuracy.
neither literal is dev-OPTIMAL -- the anchored search finds 80.37 against A7's 79.44 and 71.96 against A8's 71.03 -- which is the wrong direction for a weight vector that had been tuned on test.
verdict.why_the_from_zero_search_lands_so_low: an argmax only sees the RATIOS of the weights, so a sweep that starts at all zeros is decided by whichever column it switches on first: A7 from zero stops at group_max 0.25 + embed_bi 0.25 and 73.83, below the frozen literal's 79.44. That is a property of the procedure, not evidence about the literal, and it is why the anchored variant is reported beside it.
verdict.does_the_conclusion_depend_on_the_litera: see post_freeze_descriptive_mechanical_weights_test, which scores the anchored search's argmax on test AFTER the frozen pass: it is descriptive, it re-selects nothing, and it is the honest answer to 'would a weight vector nobody chose by hand have done this too'.

audit_candidate_provenance.note: unwinnable questions are LEFT IN every arm's denominator: their gold record carries no detected entity, so no selector over the vault's own names can reach them

audit_gold_scramble.what_it_proves: no arm's prediction depends on any gold field; the candidate set and every signal come from the vault

audit_oracle_serving.what_it_proves: every arm's tag, including the oracle's, is keyed by qid and reaches only that question -- the normalised-query-text keying that inverted an earlier conclusion in this project is structurally absent
audit_oracle_serving.what_it_does_NOT_prove: the qid half of this counter cannot fire by construction -- run_arm assigns the Selector's qid and the window's qid from one value in one statement -- so on its own it is evidence-free, and an earlier version of this file reported its zero as if it were evidence. The second key, the QUERY TEXT, is independent of the first and would fire if the engine consulted the open selector with any other text. The positive control above forces both and requires them to move. The audit that actually rules out a label leak is audit_gold_scramble.

frozen_before_test: ARMS, their weights and the injection policy (replace the engine's intent with the arm's top-1 attribute, always) were fixed from dev before the test pass and were not touched afterwards.  Nothing in this file is stochastic except the seeded bootstrap, so a re-run reproduces every number.

conclusion.headline: SELECTION without an LLM is worth +11.0 pt overall and +10.8 pt on the head-dropped questions, both with a paired 95% CI clear of zero.  That closes 44% of the oracle's overall headroom and 29% of its head-dropped headroom.
conclusion.the_prior_study_was_premature_because: raw question-vs-attribute-NAME cosine (A1) is not merely weak, it is NEGATIVE: -6.3 pt overall on test.  It was the only signal tested.  Pooling the same embeddings over an attribute's whole record GROUP (A2) instead of ranking single records is +6.7 pt, untrained; a dev-fitted bilinear map over the same vectors (A5) is +10.0 pt on exactly the head-dropped questions the name cosine could not reach.
conclusion.but_it_was_not_wrong_about_the_hard_case: the head-dropped gain is carried by the dev-fitted wording->attribute mechanisms (b) and (c).  Leave-one-ATTRIBUTE-out on dev -- where the model has never seen a question about the attribute it must pick -- collapses them to 3.7% and 1.9% selection accuracy (head-dropped: 0.0% and 2.1%).  The whole ensemble falls from 79.4% leave-one-persona-out to 57.0% leave-one-attribute-out, BELOW the untrained group cosine at 71.0%.  On an attribute a user invents tomorrow, the head-dropped question is still unsolved without an LLM or per-attribute supervision.
conclusion.answer_type_matching_is_a_clean_negative: mechanism (a), the idea the brief rated most promising, selects at 16.2% (hand-derived) and 37.9% (learned) on test and costs -38.7 pt overall.  It does NOT fail for lack of separability: an attribute's value-shape signature narrows ~24 candidates to 2.73 and is unique 43.0% of the time, and an ORACLE answer type plus a group-cosine tiebreak selects at 87.9% overall / 72.3% head-dropped.  It fails at the one step an LLM is for -- reading the answer type OFF THE QUESTION: the hand map puts the gold attribute in its predicted type tier only 57.0% of the time.
conclusion.what_the_attribute_agnostic_arm_actually: A8 clears the pre-registered bar at +5.3 pt overall, but its head-dropped delta is -1.5 pt [-6.2, 3.1] -- it does not solve the stated problem.  Its gain is on head-SURVIVING questions (81.2% against the baseline's 70.6%): group cosine resolves the attribute better than the engine's own rule table does, which is a different win and a free one.
conclusion.ships: nothing is proposed for nanomem/ by this file.  The mechanism is a drop-in replacement for entities.query_intents and the numbers above are what it is worth; the LOAO column is what it is worth on an attribute nobody labelled.

post_freeze_descriptive_mechanical_weigh.what_this_is: descriptive robustness, produced after the single frozen test pass. NOT a second selection and NOT the registered result. The weights scored here are the anchored coordinate ascent's argmax on dev, reported in audit_weight_provenance_dev.
post_freeze_descriptive_mechanical_weigh.why_it_is_here: the frozen A7/A8 literals' provenance is NOT reproducible -- see audit_weight_provenance_dev.verdict -- so the honest question is whether the conclusion depends on those particular numbers.
